build_corrected_std: build a function that corrects standard deviation using Nadeau and Bengio's approach for paired cross-validation scores
build_compute_corrected_ttest: build a function that computes a right-tailed paired t-test with variance correction for model comparison
build_grid_search_cv: build a grid search with repeated stratified k-fold cross-validation to compare SVM kernel hyperparameters
build_bayesian_posterior: build a Bayesian posterior distribution using a Student's t-distribution to compare two model performances
build_rope_analysis: build a region of practical equivalence analysis to compute probability that two models are practically equivalent
